description: Use for which states, empires or cultures had documented borders in a given year. An optional bbox selects snapshots that overlap the region. Returns a page of polities, the total count, a map link and OpenHistoricalMap attribution. Set lang to localize links. For a named polity’s lifespan or border history, use find_polity. An empty result means no matching snapshot was found in the available data.

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in degrees.

lang.description: Site language for returned page and map links. Use the language the user is writing in.

limit.description: Maximum results to return in this page.

offset.description: Pass the previous result’s next_offset with the same filters to continue.

year.description: Year. Negative is BC: -500 = 500 BC. There is no year 0.

name: world_at_year

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page with the same filters, or null at the end.

returned.description: Number of records in this page.
